description: Expected results for the official MONICA Hohenfinow2 example (zalf-rpm/monica installer/Hohenfinow2, sim.json + crop.json + site.json + climate.csv, 1991-1997 crop rotation at Hohenfinow, Brandenburg, Germany). inputs/ are the unmodified files from the MONICA git tree. Values were recorded from real runs of the server's monica-run 3.6.53.0; three clean runs (two through the KI run tool, one direct) gave byte-identical output (sha256 33ed0613...829c), so the model is deterministic here. The tracked out.csv / min-out-monica.csv in the example folder are NOT used: their columns do not match any of the current sim*.json files, so they come from an older setup and cannot be compared.
engine_version: monica-run 3.6.53.0 (zalf-rpm/monica git f821718), monica-parameters git fb0f478

numeric_checks.name: n_daily_rows
numeric_checks.why: one daily row per day 1991-01-01..1997-12-31 (start/end dates set in the official sim.json)

numeric_checks.name: n_monthly_rows
numeric_checks.why: 7 years x 12 months in the monthly section

numeric_checks.name: n_yearly_rows
numeric_checks.why: one row per year 1991-1997 in the yearly section

numeric_checks.name: n_crops
numeric_checks.why: the 7 crops of the official rotation in crop.json (rye, silage maize, potato, winter wheat, winter barley, spring barley, winter rape)

numeric_checks.name: run_precip_sum_mm
numeric_checks.why: whole-run rain total from the 'run' section; equals the climate.csv rain for the period

numeric_checks.name: daily_precip_sum_mm
numeric_checks.why: sum of daily Precip must match the run total (inner consistency)

numeric_checks.name: sum_crop_yields
numeric_checks.why: sum of all 7 crop yields; winter barley (harvested 1996-04-13) and winter rape (sown 1997-04-04, harvested 1997-07-08) give 0 with the official dates

numeric_checks.name: max_daily_LAI
numeric_checks.why: largest daily leaf area index over the run [m2/m2], as MONICA writes it

numeric_checks.name: sum_yearly_NLeach
numeric_checks.why: nitrate leaching summed over the 7 yearly rows [kgN/ha]

numeric_checks.name: sum_yearly_Recharge
numeric_checks.why: groundwater recharge summed over the 7 yearly rows [mm]

finished_normally: run tool tools/run_monica.py returns rc 0 and status 'success', and sim-out.csv is written (monica-run prints no success line; it is silent on success)
reference: own run (no matching official reference output ships with the example); output sha256 33ed06134972e98b27c60208aa0249d743ffcd7449728c355b84b5f946d2829c
